description:
Shape the future of spatial computing by building rendering technologies for Apple Vision Pro and next-generation vision products. As part of the RealityKit team, you'll architect and optimize systems that bring spatial media to life, transforming how millions experience immersive photos, videos, and 3D content in visionOS.

Develop high-performance rendering pipelines that blend digital content with the physical world, optimize GPU workloads for high visual fidelity, and build new techniques for spatial video playback and 3D media presentation. Your work will directly impact how users capture memories, consume entertainment, and interact with spatial content across Apple's vision ecosystem.

Description
As a Media Pipeline Engineer on the RealityKit team, you'll architect and implement rendering systems that power spatial media experiences across visionOS and Apple Vision Pro. You'll develop GPU pipelines for spatial photo and video playback, optimize real-time rendering of 3D content with techniques like foveated rendering and temporal reprojection, and collaborate with media frameworks, Metal, and hardware teams to maximize visual quality while maintaining smooth performance. Your work will span the full rendering stack, from low-level shader optimization and memory management to high-level API design, giving developers powerful, intuitive tools to create spatial experiences. You'll tackle challenges like efficient multi-view rendering and integration of spatial media with virtual content, while meeting Apple's standards for performance and user experience.

Responsibilities
Design and implement high-performance rendering pipelines for spatial photos, videos, and 3D media in RealityKit
Optimize GPU shaders and rendering algorithms to achieve strong visual quality and frame rates on Apple silicon
Build intuitive APIs that enable developers to integrate spatial media into visionOS applications
Profile and debug rendering issues across the graphics stack using Instruments and GPU debugging tools
Prototype rendering features for future vision products and evaluate emerging graphics technologies
Write unit tests and performance benchmarks to ensure rendering quality and stability
Contribute to technical specifications and documentation for spatial media rendering capabilities
Mentor engineers and conduct code reviews to maintain high engineering standards

Minimum qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of professional experience in real-time graphics programming, with exposure to media playback systems
Strong proficiency in C++ and shader programming languages (Metal Shading Language, GLSL, or HLSL)
Solid understanding of modern graphics APIs (Metal, Vulkan, or DirectX 12) and GPU architecture
Familiarity with foveated rendering, temporal reprojection, or other advanced real-time rendering techniques
Understanding of GPU texture management and efficient frame buffer handling, and experience optimizing rendering
Proficiency with performance profiling tools like Instruments, RenderDoc, or similar GPU debuggers
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug complex rendering issues
Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Preferred qualifications
Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Graphics, or related field
7+ years of experience shipping media rendering features in high-profile consumer products
Knowledge of spatial media formats, codecs, color spaces, and video decoding pipelines
Experience with media frameworks such as AVFoundation, Core Media, or video encoding/decoding APIs
Experience with stereoscopic or multi-view video rendering for VR/AR applications
